Also verify no HF token issue — the pyannote diarization model requires an HF token for gated access; with placeholder token, diarization may fail. But the guide says token needed for model download. Let me check if models fully downloaded (3GB suggests yes). Let me test the ASR ping and stats. Also check whether transcription works - but running a job requires actual audio. I could generate a small audio file and drop into watch dir? That "normal runtime file creation" is permitted. But it requires ffmpeg maybe. Let me check if ffmpeg exists. Actually running a transcription may take very long on CPU. Let me at least do ping checks.

Let me check the API ping endpoints and ASR status/gpu.
